Seating Chart Maker

Assign guests to a random seating chart grid — set rows and columns, paste the guest list, and shuffle until everyone has a seat.

–
Seats
–
Assigned

📖 How to use

  1. Set the number of rows and columns for your room layout.
  2. Paste one guest name per line.
  3. Press Assign seats — shuffle again any time.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are seats assigned?

Guests are shuffled with Fisher-Yates and dealt into seats left to right, top to bottom.

How are seats numbered?

Seat numbers run 1..N across rows, so you can print the chart and label tables easily.

What if guests outnumber seats?

Extra seats stay empty, and if there are more guests than seats you get a clear error asking to add rows or columns.

Can I re-shuffle?

Press Shuffle again — every press re-randomizes the whole chart.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
